title: How To Craft INSANE End Game Rings For CHEAP!
creator: XTheFarmerX

base.name: unstated

otherMods: tier one of any flat attack damage, ideally fire or lightning (not physical, not cold), plus an open suffix or a good resistance roll

priceClaim.quote: I was paying one div for the open suffix and then two div for the good resistance rolls.

base.quote: buying a ton of these magic rings that have tier one of any flat on them.

target.text: fill the open suffix of the magic ring (hit rarity or resistance)

steps.quote: what we're going to do is perfect all the open suffix rings. Awesome. So, we hit one rarity, one resistance.
steps.note: 'Perfect all the open suffix rings' is a Perfect Orb of Augmentation on the magic ring, applied BEFORE any essence; it is not an Exalted Orb (a magic ring takes an Augmentation, and the rare-making essences follow at 1:17–1:32). The orb is read from context; he says only 'perfect'.

target.text: tier three resistance on rings that already have rarity (fire or lightning, not cold)

steps.quote: you can then use a greater essence of insulation. You can do the fire or the lightning one, but don't do the cold one
you're going to want to use an essence of opulence. This will guarantee you tier one rarity.
steps.note: Used on the rings that already rolled a resistance.

target.text: flat attack damage or percentage cold damage; rarity and life also accepted

steps.quote: preserve quality bone, ominous ancestral decrement seed to guarantee a prefix desecration on all of our rings.
steps.note: Captions garble the names; read as Preserved Collarbone and Omen of Sinistral Necromancy (guarantees a prefix). This is the order of the first craft; in the second, cheaper craft he slams first and applies the collarbone only to rings that hit (9:45–10:15).

target.text: flat cold damage to attacks, percentage cold damage, cold or all resistance

steps.quote: catalyze all these rings with these cold catalysts, and then we're going to use an omen of catalyzing exaltation, an omen of greater exaltation
steps.note: Cold catalyst instead of Reaver (attack) because it adds no bad-mod weight and is far cheaper (3:22–3:50). Greater Exalted Orb chosen over Perfect: perfect only removes one mod from the pool for roughly 2.5-3 div more (4:58–5:25). The catalysing omen applies to both exalts of the greater omen (4:07–4:19).

target.text: flat damage, rarity or life (a cold flat if missing)

steps.quote: We're going to definitely want to grab an echo and unveil.
steps.note: Reveal step. 'Echo' read as Omen of Abyssal Echoes (about 1.5 div). Taken only on rings worth it; skipped on a ring with two weak suffixes (11:09–11:15).

caveats: Expect to craft two or three rings to hit one (1:04–1:05).
Do not spend more than about two or three div on a base because many will brick (0:54–0:59).
T1 physical flat has the highest weighting, so a base that already has it lowers the odds of hitting another flat; cold is avoided on the base because it is wanted later (0:25–0:41).
Reaver catalyst gives more flat chances but is about six times the price of the cold catalyst; cold catalyst adds no weight to bad mods (3:22–4:06).
He tested the catalysing omen with the Omen of Greater Exaltation (applies to both exalts) and says it worked last league (4:09–4:19).
Second craft: collarbone only on rings whose catalysed slam hit, to save cost (9:45–10:15); the first craft desecrated first.
Other bases work: gold, prismatic or any resistance ring; gold rarity bases sell best but cost more (8:48–9:01).
Unsold rings are not catalysed, so he adds a cold catalyst to look better in the trade filter (8:02–8:20); he lowers listings by a div every hour or few hours (14:01–14:07).
Second craft, four rings (14:26–14:44): one hard brick, a second ring he also calls a miss (kept at about 3 div); recorded as a measured brick_rate with n=4.
